description: This source file defines the ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner class, which inherits from TransactionTestRunnerBase and provides methods for running fault-injected transaction tests on Orleans grains, including single grain read/write and multi-grain fault-injected transactions.

classes.name: ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for fault injection testing of transactions in Orleans grains, supporting single grain and multi-grain transaction scenarios with fault injection control.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read transaction on a single grain, verifies the value, and deactivates the grain.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a single grain by adding a delta and verifies the updated value.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction_FaultInjection
methods.description: Performs a coordinated multi-grain write transaction with fault injection, handling various fault scenarios and retries.
